name: RIKEN and Fujitsu Fugaku supercomputer
description: RIKEN and Fujitsu's Fugaku system at Kobe used Arm-based A64FX nodes linked by Tofu Interconnect D. It reached 442.01 PFlop/s on LINPACK in the November 2020 TOP500 ranking and opened for shared research use in March 2021.

date.basis: RIKEN dates the start of trial use to April 2020.

events.statement: RIKEN began trial use of Fugaku for selected research projects during final preparations for shared service.

evidence.supports: Operator distinguishes April 2020 trial use from the March 2021 shared opening.
Locates the Fugaku installation at RIKEN in Kobe.

date.basis: Month of the first TOP500 reporting of the measured result.

events.statement: Fugaku's June configuration recorded 415.53 PFlop/s in the TOP500 LINPACK benchmark.

evidence.supports: The June row gives Rmax 415.53 PFlop/s.

date.basis: RIKEN dates the benchmark result announcement to 16 November Japan time.

events.statement: The November benchmark ranking announced a measured LINPACK result of 442.01 PFlop/s for Fugaku.

evidence.supports: Dates the rankings announcement and identifies the measured LINPACK result.
The system history distinguishes 442.01 PFlop/s Rmax from 537.21 PFlop/s theoretical Rpeak.

date.basis: RIKEN marks completion and start of shared use on the same day.

events.statement: RIKEN completed development with Fujitsu and opened Fugaku for shared research use by selected projects.

evidence.supports: RIKEN documents completion, shared use and RIST’s role in project selection.

date.basis: RIKEN's 17 November notice retrospectively dates the suspension.

events.statement: RIKEN suspended Fugaku operations and external access on 14 November 2026.
events.scope: Operations suspension pending remediation and a later restart decision.

evidence.locator: §1 Timeline, §4 RIKEN’s response and §5 Future actions
evidence.supports: The operator dates the suspension and says resumption depends on remediation.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest retained practical use of the named Kobe system. The prototype and installation are separate stages.

research.note: The link concerns the interconnect design only. The historical benchmark remains distinct from the live operating status.

places.note: RIKEN Center for Computational Science in Kobe.

measures.subject: Fugaku, November 2020 listed configuration
measures.conditions: HPL Rmax for the listed configuration, reported November 2020.

links.statement: Fugaku’s Tofu Interconnect D adapted Fujitsu’s Tofu2 design. It retained the six-dimensional mesh/torus and on-chip controller, changing link provisioning and adding resilience features for denser systems.
links.scope: Fujitsu interconnect architecture across FX100-era Tofu2 and Fugaku's A64FX-integrated TofuD.

evidence.locator: P. 7, TofuD overview; p. 8, Dynamic packet slicing
evidence.supports: Fujitsu explicitly traces TofuD to Tofu2 for FX100 and describes high-density and resilience changes.
External technical report independently identifies Tofu2 as the predecessor-generation interconnect and compares topology, integration and link provisioning.
